annotations.bnjettag.io/telemetry-only: GPU-product throughput benchmark, campaigns/2026-09-29-gpu-benchmark; nothing it writes is a result
annotations.bnjettag.io/gpu-product: NVIDIA-A100-SXM4-80GB via nvidia.com/a100 (81920 MiB, node label nvidia.com/gpu.memory)
annotations.bnjettag.io/phases: p1-E-k16 p2-A07-k8 p3-E-k4 p4-A07-k2; stop_after 21 (traced epochs 1, 10, 20)
annotations.bnjettag.io/k-rule: K_rule = floor(0.9 x 81920 / per-process MiB), per-process E 4350 / A07 8446 (A10, TF_FORCE_GPU_ALLOW_GROWTH, nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps: E 4,350 MiB (K=5 pod, c5805), A07 8,446 MiB (K=3 pods, gpu-16 and gpu-17); campaigns/2026-09-26-training-batch/RUN.md "Takeover check, 2026-09-29T02:47-03:10Z"); K_low = A10 K of the class (E 4, A07 2), or K_run - 1 where K_run <= it (STUDY.md [D2])
annotations.bnjettag.io/k-caps: E: K_rule 16, K_run 16, K_low 4 (no cap binds); A07: K_rule 8, K_run 8, K_low 2 (no cap binds)
annotations.bnjettag.io/per-arm-resources: 2 CPU and 8Gi per arm at the largest K (16); smaller phases leave the rest unused
annotations.bnjettag.io/wandb: disabled: no secret mounted, WANDB_MODE=disabled, bench_driver calls ablation.run_training(remote=False)
annotations.bnjettag.io/gpu-fingerprint: kai-chang0926-fp-e9511d1aeb sha256 e9511d1aeb39c7c8: chang0926-a-n64-s1 initial_ebops == 11559681 before any arm, else exit 9 (Delta REGRESSION_TICKET); a mismatch on a new product is a finding
annotations.bnjettag.io/retries: backoffLimit 0 and no podFailurePolicy: never re-run automatically (a preempted pod fails the Job)
annotations.bnjettag.io/active-deadline: pod 58800 s from pod start = 1800 s header + per phase (K x 21 x A10 s/run-epoch E 28 / A07 44 x 2.5 + 15 s x K + 900 s), rounded up to 600 s; Job 80400 s from creation (Pending counts) = the 21600 s [D6] window + the pod bound, a backstop
annotations.bnjettag.io/not-practical-after: 6 h after kubectl apply with no Running pod: delete the Job and keep the PodScheduled message (STUDY [D6], exclusion rule 3); cluster-ops
annotations.bnjettag.io/narrow-pool: one product on purpose: the controlled timing comparison the setup doc (Pool policy) allows; decisions.md 2026-09-29; ends when the benchmark Jobs are deleted
annotations.bnjettag.io/node-survey: node_survey_20260929T065531Z.json (read 2026-09-29T06:55:31Z): 16 schedulable of 22 nodes; 16 can hold this pod by allocatable

containers.name: bench
args:
set -euo pipefail
BR=/data/chang-n64-20260926/gpu-bench/a100-sxm4-80gb
echo "BENCH_POD ${POD_NAME:-na} product NVIDIA-A100-SXM4-80GB slug a100-sxm4-80gb $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
echo "HOSTNAME_NODE ${NODE_NAME:-na}"
if [ -e "$BR/samples.csv" ] || compgen -G "$BR/p[0-9]*" > /dev/null; then echo "BENCH_ROOT_NOT_EMPTY $BR: move it aside (never delete), then re-apply"; exit 11; fi
mkdir -p "$BR"
exec > >(tee -a "$BR/pod-${POD_NAME:-pod}.log") 2>&1
export KERAS_BACKEND=tensorflow MPLBACKEND=Agg TF_CPP_MIN_LOG_LEVEL=2
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 TF_NUM_INTRAOP_THREADS=2 TF_NUM_INTEROP_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1
mkdir -p /work/code
echo '42abed4b5d2e3e9197d36a5031754cfde342fc7b0d03f7bb0106ce16c2e258c0  /cmcode/hgq2.tar.gz' | sha256sum -c -
tar -xzf /cmcode/hgq2.tar.gz -C /work/code --strip-components=1
export PYTHONPATH=/work/code
export BNJ_DATA_ROOT=/data/chang-n64-20260926 BNJ_RUN_ROOT="$BR" BNJ_CAMPAIGN_DIR=/work/code/campaigns/chang0926
unset BNJ_STAGE WANDB_PROJECT WANDB_ENTITY WANDB_API_KEY WANDB_TAGS
export WANDB_MODE=disabled
export TF_FORCE_GPU_ALLOW_GROWTH=true NVIDIA_TF32_OVERRIDE=0
export BNJ_RSS_GATE_LIMIT_MB=8192 BNJ_RSS_GATE_WINDOW=5:105
pip install -q --no-cache-dir -r /work/code/requirements-training.txt
NVLIBS=$(python -c "import glob; print(':'.join(sorted(glob.glob('/usr/local/lib/python*/site-packages/nvidia/*/lib'))))")
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$NVLIBS${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:+:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH}"
cd /work/code
MSHA=$(python -c "import run_study; print(run_study.manifest()['sha256'])")
test "$MSHA" = "041f981a9d5b8c3a7affb175d82de0ca2df9bc6261a172f67cb365c88b4bbd42" || { echo "MANIFEST_SHA_MISMATCH $MSHA"; exit 1; }
echo "MANIFEST_SHA_OK $MSHA"
export BNHGQ2_CODE_SHA256="$MSHA"
python -c "import tensorflow as tf; assert tf.config.list_physical_devices('GPU'); print('GPU_GATE_PASS')"
test -f /data/chang-n64-20260926/n64/data/READY.json || { echo "CACHE_NOT_READY"; exit 1; }
echo CACHE_READY
echo "GPU_INFO $(nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,memory.total,driver_version --format=csv,noheader || echo na)"
df -h /data
echo "PIP_FREEZE_SHA256 $(python -m pip freeze --all | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)"
echo 'e9511d1aeb39c7c8e48cc7dbc148ac623f3b2d9844d108da38f1ecfa2bdff1f1  /cmfp/fingerprint_check.py' | sha256sum -c -
FP=0
python -u /cmfp/fingerprint_check.py --run chang0926-a-n64-s1 --expect 11559681 --data-root /data/chang-n64-20260926 --campaign-dir /work/code/campaigns/chang0926 --env-report || FP=$?
if [ "$FP" != 0 ]; then echo "FINGERPRINT_GATE_FAIL exit=$FP node=${NODE_NAME:-na}; no arm started"; exit "$FP"; fi
echo '4d2dcd7d9cebf85d1da985122053741a18046e3b48bafdbf1082b06877c40c22  /cmbench/bench_driver.py' | sha256sum -c -
exec python -u /cmbench/bench_driver.py pod --bench-root "$BR" --plan-json "$BENCH_PLAN"
